## How to test

Steps a reviewer can follow to check the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Python files compile (`python3 -m py_compile publisher/*.py`) if changed
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, publisher/README.md or data contract)
- [ ] No credentials, broker passwords or `.env.local` files committed
